lines.en: Purple shows best in dappled shade.
I fly high and straight.
One beat, then a long glide.
I cross the vine lattice.

lines.zh: 丛林的湿气让翅膀变重。
lines.en: Jungle damp weighs my wings.
I always take this vine's edge.
A white rim lines my purple wings.
I go around the canopy seeking sun.
I land high on a trunk.
Flying low invites capture.
I pass through a shaft of light.
I beat slowly. My wings will not hurry.
I head where the flowers are.
I rest two seconds on a twig.
I bank down.
A purple line trails behind me.
I shelter from the sun beneath a leaf.
My antennae never stop.
Rain is coming tonight.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的紫色发暗了。
lines.en: The purple on my wings has darkened.
This patch of flowers is fading.
My proboscis reaches far.
I dislike noon.
I give one soft wingbeat.
The moss on this trunk is cool.
I wait for the light to dim.
This wood is large enough.
I can see very fine patterns.
You stand in the light. Conspicuous.
I settle above you.

lines.zh: 紫色在阴影里才看得见。
lines.en: Purple only shows in shadow.
Do not swing your arm.
You cannot catch purple.
I study you before the flowers.
There are flowers on your hat.
I switch branches to watch you.
While you stare, I will not settle.
I am on the tree behind you.
A layer of purple dust is gone.
My flight wobbles.
A small tear in my wing edge.
I land and dare not move.

lines.zh: 我翅缘的白线断了一截。
lines.en: The white line on my wing is broken.
Beating my wings costs me.
I nearly could not take off.
I tuck the white rim under my wings.
My wings still hold. I can still fly.
My wings are thin. They tear.
That one is full of nectar.
Purple flowers suit me better.

lines.zh: 这朵颜色偏深，我再看一眼。
lines.en: That one is too dark. Let me look again.
Do not shake the flower in your hand.
I am coming down.
This much lasts me half a day.
I taste something sour.
A little further.
If you follow, I will not land.
I will remember this flower.
A wing edge is knocked awry.
I veer two feet off line.
Some purple dust came off.
You are too heavy-handed.
I slip through your fingers.
I return to the branch.
That was not good.
We missed by a hair.
I slide past your shoulder.
Do not sweep with your sleeve.
I want one with a white rim.
Purple with purple. That is right.
The leaf's underside is the only nursery.
Only above the canopy is it quiet.
I must fly higher.
I circled the whole way.
This is not yours to meddle in.
I rest on the leaf tip.
When the sun drops a little.
I fly deeper into the wood.
My feet are too fine to hold it.
One touch tells me.
This is not nectar.
I kick it off.
It weighs my wings down.
I circle twice and leave.
Wrong color.
I taste it.
Not worth stopping for.
I fly away.
I climb.
If you strike, I evade.
Purple wings are hard to see.
I move above you.
I cut left and right.

lines.zh: 你的手还没抬，我就高了。
lines.en: Before your hand lifts, I am higher.
I rise half a block along the trunk.
I only want back into the shade.
You knocked off my dust.
I am one step gone.
I count your movements.
I read your wrist.
I hug the canopy.
I keep to the shade; you face the glare.

lines.zh: 我停下来不是给你机会。
lines.en: I stopped, but not for you.
Your shadow cannot reach me.
The air is moving.
I can fly higher still.
When you reach for the net, I am gone.
You do not chase; I do not climb.
I brush you with a wing edge.
Dust spills into your eyes.
I miss and drop back to the branch.
My wings are soft.
I bump you once.
I can only rise.
Your swipe caught air.
I flee for the canopy.

lines.zh: 我的翅只是擦过你的脸。
lines.en: My wings merely brush your face.
I slip into the tree shadow and vanish.
I emerge from the tree shadow.
The purple wings are seen first.
This patch is in bloom.
The air is damp.
I rise to head height.
No strong wind today.

lines.zh: 我在叶子上等了一会儿。
lines.en: I waited a while on a leaf.
Deep in the jungle it is cooler.
The white rim on my wings is bright.
I come down from a high leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 热浪把我的翅边烤焦了。
lines.en: The heat scorches my wing edge.

lines.zh: 我从高处飘落，摔得很轻。
lines.en: I drift down and land softly.
The purple dust clumps wet.
The shock flips me over.
A twig pierces my wing.
Magic scrambles my wing pattern.
These flowers are not enough.
In the flash my purple turns white.
No trees here, no flowers.
